asserts: Every database URL CI's own probe requires is one the builder's run takes from CI's test-infra action, so a local run never fails or skips a database suite CI runs.

guard.ref: tooling/scripts/ci-checks.test.mjs#CI's database environment is read from the test-infra action, every per-service URL included

why: Runs assert-test-db-env.mjs as CI does (CI=true, psql a stand-in that answers): with no URLs it names each key it requires, and with ciTestEnv's environment it passes with none unset.

asserts: The packages a builder's run tests, builds and typechecks are CI's own selection, made against the branch's merge-base with origin/main.

guard.ref: tooling/scripts/ci-checks.test.mjs#the package selection is CI's own functions, called with the merge-base

why: Runs ci-checks.mjs whole in a planted checkout one commit past origin/main, with pnpm a stand-in that logs its calls, and asserts turbo's test, build and typecheck runs each get --filter=...[<merge-base sha>].

asserts: No check the run starts inherits a hook's GIT_* variables, so a tooling test's temp repo never writes into the real one.

guard.ref: tooling/scripts/ci-checks.test.mjs#the checks never inherit a hook's GIT_* variables

why: The same planted run, started with a GIT_* variable set: every check it starts (gates, look drift, prettier, turbo, psql, the database probe) logs the GIT_* names it was handed, and each list is empty.

asserts: Main's look-drift.mjs, written to a temp folder, really runs when the tmpdir is a symlink (the Mac's is), instead of exiting 0 having done nothing.

guard.ref: tooling/scripts/ci-checks.test.mjs#look drift runs main's script from a real path

why: The planted run sets TMPDIR to a symlink and plants a main look-drift.mjs that logs only when it runs as itself: it logs once, from the real folder.

asserts: Matching, ledger, identity and trade each boot with their D-44 smoke integers, so none boots on a blank that its schema refuses.

guard.ref: tooling/scripts/order-path-cx8-boot.test.mjs#each booted process spreads that role env

why: Runs the boot script whole against stand-in services that log the environment they were started with, and asserts each role's process got every cx8RoleEnv value.

asserts: Matching starts only after the two smoke founders are enrolled and is given exactly their two user ids as its operators (#4724).

guard.ref: tooling/scripts/order-path-cx8-boot.test.mjs#matching boots after founder enrolment and is given exactly the two smoke founder ids

why: In the same boot, the enrolment stand-in prints two founders: matching's start comes after the enrolment's, once, with MATCHING_OPERATOR_IDS exactly their ids, and identity's second boot pins that pair.

asserts: svc-bank boots with the custody switch the rig's svc-ledger runs, and no second key or later spread silently overrides it (project-state#2520).

guard.ref: tooling/scripts/order-path-cx8-boot.test.mjs#svc-bank is given the custody switch once

why: In the same boot with CX8_AFTER set, svc-bank starts once and its LEDGER_CUSTODY_LAYER equals svc-ledger's (on), as do matching's and trade's: a second key or a spread after it that changed the value fails.

asserts: A verify drive, whole or of steps, and a look record nothing in .jr/run.json, so no drive ever stands for the journey's first-push record (project-state #3021).

guard.ref: tooling/scripts/verify-app.test.mjs#run.json: a drive, whole or of steps, records nothing

why: Runs verify-app's main for drive (whole and #1) and look in a planted checkout with a live slot, a stand-in stack and a passing Playwright stand-in: each ends PASS with its evidence and .jr/run.json does not exist, while realIo().record, the one writer, does write it there.

asserts: A re-run whose records already exist skips the file-list steps and still runs the rest.
why: Not source text: the test copied run.mjs into a sandbox to execute it and asserts on the calls it makes; it now copies the file with copyFileSync, which moves the file to run it and reads none of its words.
